desc:
A secret angle is hidden on the wheel between two opposites… can your friends read your brainwave and find it? 🧠⚡
(REQUIRES 2 PLAYERS)

How to play:
Each round, one player becomes the Psychic and sees the secret spot on the wheel.

- The Psychic gets a topic (like Spicy 🌶 – Not Spicy 🧊) and gives one clue.

- Everyone else moves the pointer to where they think the clue lands on the circle.

- The closer you are to the secret spot, the more points & gems you earn 💎

Controls:
💻 PC - Click & drag the pointer, or use ←/→
📱 Mobile - Drag the pointer with your finger
🎮 Console - RT/RB + LT/LB to move the pointer

Earn gems, flex your brain, and see who’s truly on your wavelength 😈✨

Inspired by Wavelength from TikTok, and Telepathy!
